heroSummary: Alpine School District students began Wednesday, August 13, 2025. Kindergarten assessment days ran August 13–18, followed by the first regular kindergarten day on August 19. PreK ended May 21, and the final districtwide student day was Friday, May 22, 2026, a Minimal Day. The archived calendar labels each instructional date as an A or B day.
calendarNotes: Most Alpine School District students began August 13, while kindergarten used an August 13–18 assessment window before regular attendance began August 19. The archived calendar assigns an A or B label to instructional dates, with March 11 marked for the high-school ACT. Fall Break ended October 17, but students remained out October 20 for teacher professional development. Thanksgiving combined a teacher comp day on November 26 with the November 27–28 break. December 19 and May 22 were Minimal Days, and PreK did not attend either date. Winter Break ended January 2, followed by a staff workday January 5 before students returned January 6. PreK’s last day was May 21, one day before the districtwide last day.

customSections.content: The archived official PDF labels instructional dates A or B. The letters identify the school-day rotation; they do not mean school was closed or shortened. calendarFaqs.q: When did Alpine School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students started Wednesday, August 13, 2025. Kindergarten assessment days ran August 13–18, and the first regular kindergarten day was Tuesday, August 19.

calendarFaqs.q: What were A and B days in Alpine School District?
calendarFaqs.a: A and B identified Alpine’s alternating school-day rotation. The archived official PDF printed the applicable letter inside each instructional date.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Alpine School District Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break was October 16–17, 2025. Students also had no school Monday, October 20 for teacher professional development and returned Tuesday, October 21.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Alpine School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students remained out January 5 for a staff workday and returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Alpine School District Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, April 6, through Friday, April 10, 2026. April 6 was also a PTC Teacher Comp Day. Students returned Monday, April 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school for Alpine in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: PreK’s last day was Thursday, May 21, 2026. The final districtwide student day was Friday, May 22, a Minimal Day when PreK did not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloadable Alpine calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import for an archived school year and does not include daily A/B labels.

sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the archived Alpine calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The one-page archived PDF is titled Alpine School District 2025–2026 Calendar, is board approved April 23, 2024, and is marked updated February 18, 2025.

The PDF was rendered and checked visually because its color legend, A/B letters, Minimal Day corners, term endings, and overlapping staff/break labels carry information that text extraction alone does not preserve.

The district’s current calendar page does not provide a stable public 2025–26 PDF URL. This page therefore records the reviewed archived source without presenting a fabricated or unverified PDF download.
Kindergarten assessment days are presented as an assigned planning window, not as four ordinary full-attendance days.
The archived calendar lists a kindergarten first day but does not publish a PreK opening date. No PreK first day is inferred.
The .ics file is a one-time import for an archived school year and omits daily A/B labels.
